ACTREC Project Nurse III Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Nurse III post under the project titled “A Centre for the Advanced Research for Validating Medical Device in a Tertiary Care Cancer Hospital”.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Project Nurse III Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: B.Sc. Nursing (Registered with MNC-Maharashtra Nursing Council). 2 years’ experience as a Staff Nurse / Research nurse.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Project Nurse III Salary
content_sections.text: The duration of the post is six months, and the work progress of the candidate will be monitored for extension after 6 months.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Project Nurse III Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is conducted through a walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ACTREC Project Nurse III Walk-In
content_sections.text: Recent CV Original and xerox copies of all educational certificates Original and xerox copies of all work experience documents Recent passport size photograph ID proof (Preferably Aadhaar Card)

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for ACTREC Project Nurse-III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Project Nurse-III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 21st October, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time is between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at Khanolkar Shodhika, Meeting Room 1, ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210.
